project: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 - Terrestrial Lunar Analog Discovery Engine

matched_analog_pairs.formal_name: Corona Lava Tube System & Malpaís de la Corona
matched_analog_pairs.geological_facies: Sub-surface Basaltic Lava Tube Conduits & Skylights
matched_analog_pairs.lithology: Alkaline basalt, olivine tholeiite, volcanic jameos (roof collapses)
matched_analog_pairs.nasa_mission_context: ESA PANGAEA & PANGAEA-X planetary astronaut field training program for lunar sub-surface exploration.
matched_analog_pairs.scientific_viability_desc: Direct geometric and geotechnical analog for lunar lava tube habitats sheltering from radiation and micrometeorites.
matched_analog_pairs.habitat_utility: Elevated Highland Plateau Base Camp (Large Surface Area, Optimal Power & Traverse)

matched_analog_pairs.formal_name: Asgard Range & Beacon Valley, McMurdo Dry Valleys
matched_analog_pairs.lithology: Ferrar Dolerite sills, Beacon Sandstone, cryogenic regolith, dry permafrost
matched_analog_pairs.nasa_mission_context: NASA Astrobiology & Planetary Geology benchmark polar analog. Liquid water-free permafrost mimicking lunar cryogenic regolith.
matched_analog_pairs.scientific_viability_desc: Matches high-relief, razor-thin ridge crests and cryogenic thermal conditions of Lunar South Pole permanent illumination peaks.
matched_analog_pairs.landing_safety_rating: Category 3: Rugged Ridge/Massif (Hazardous, Highland Traverse Only)
matched_analog_pairs.habitat_utility: High-Elevation Peak of Eternal Light & Direct-to-Earth Telemetry Station Analog

matched_analog_pairs.nasa_mission_context: NASA Haughton-Mars Project (HMP) and Mars Institute analog base camp since 1997.
matched_analog_pairs.scientific_viability_desc: Cold, unvegetated impact structure replicating degraded crater rim morphology and rover traversability under polar lighting.
